QUOTE: In a default build, a field `flags` is really named `private_flags`. ... Defining `MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS` makes the macro the identity, so bare `ctx->flags` compiles.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer shows the macro renaming to private_##member by default and expanding to the unchanged member when MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS is defined.
